---
title: "08-nanoplot"
output: html_document
date: "2025-10-26"
---



```{bash}
mkdir -p ../analyses/09-nanoplot/

for fq in ../data/pacbio-reads/fastq/*.fastq; do
    sample=$(basename "$fq" .fastq)
    echo "Running NanoPlot on $sample"
    
    /opt/anaconda/anaconda3/envs/nanoplot_env/bin/NanoPlot --fastq "$fq" \
             -o ../analyses/09-nanoplot/"$sample" \
             --threads 40 \
             --loglength \
             --tsv_stats
done
```
